shortcut_vulnerability.interpretation: Conditional label/nuisance associations identify candidates for controlled downstream tests.

conditional_associations.definition: MI / sqrt(H(nuisance)*H(binary class presence)); undefined for constant variables
conditional_associations.limitations: Descriptive annotation associations; class co-occurrence and collection design confound results. Correlation does not establish a trained model uses a shortcut.

discriminative_information.interpretation: Encoder similarities identify review candidates; discriminability of the target model remains unverified.

independent_evidence_and_redundancy.interpretation: Collection groups and duplicates constrain evidence interpretation; sample adequacy remains task/model-specific.

potential_deployment_domain_shift.interpretation: Descriptive reference differences; downstream degradation requires independent model evaluation.

disclaimer: Research dataset-readiness assessment only; not official aviation safety certification or a guarantee of model performance.
